summary: Diag2: F-weighted and whitened-PCA RBF SMV planes plus inherited-bias calibration
reasoning: Step-13 contradicted step-11: no screen (F/RF/MI, k up to 50) lifts honest SVM cv past 0.673 vs forest 0.7267, and all-500 features score ~0.58, so the deficit is the SVM's distance geometry on noisy selected features, not the screen identity. New pilot-only idea set: weight selected standardized features by their fold-train F-score (schemes: min-max F, rank) so RBF distances concentrate on informative dims; and a whitened-PCA variant (rotation inside the watched-feature span); plus a wider local-gamma grid, and a static-screen logreg calibration to reproduce the inherited 0.76. Expectation: some configuration reaches plain-5-fold (fold-refit screens, seed 0) mean AUC >= 0.70, the level from which a repeated-nested estimate could support a 0.71 holdout; recorded as flat-numeric cv_auc and n_features <= 50. Reads only data/pilot.csv.
